notes: The frame's *that* goes to the apodosis waw (rule 45); the italic *saying* answers to no verb of speaking in the verse and is added (rules 7, 20).
The temporal לְ takes *when* even though its object is a noun rather than an infinitive (rule 52); תְקֻפוֹת is recast as the predicate *was come about* and takes the construction's copula (rule 20).
